msg: The important factor is the colour of the gnome. You will always be choosing between a gnome that takes you to a dark forest and a gnome that takes you to a brighter forest. Green, Orange, Red and Blue will lead to the brighter forest. Pink, Brown, Yellow and Purple lead to the darker forest. At any time, one forest will have better odds to give lots of mushrooms. But this will switch periodically. You must track which forest is giving better rewards and try to visit that one. Use the 1x multiplier rounds to test the forests and see what the rewards are. Use the 5x multipliers to gain lots of points!The odds of the forests may switch after a few rounds, or many, so be willing to test and switch often if needed. However, sometimes the better forest may give a low reward, there is an element of chance.
